artifact_review: The Router correctly identified 'text_gibberish' as a severe artifact (severity 4). The 'structural_collapse' of the top edge (severity 3) is also a critical finding; real cassettes are rigid injection-molded plastic, and a wavy top edge is a significant geometric failure. The 'texture_anomaly' (severity 2) and 'blur' (severity 2) are consistent with AI generation smoothing. The Perceptual Quality Auditor's finding of 'compression' is likely misinterpreting the AI's smooth/waxy texture as compression artifacts; the root cause is generative smoothing, not compression. The Topology Boundary Auditor's high confidence mask confirms the object is a single entity, but does not rule out the internal geometric softness observed by the Router.

The geometry is mostly correct (rectangular prism, spools visible), but the lack of precise industrial design features lowers the alignment score significantly below a perfect 5.0.
artifact_reasoning: Severe text gibberish (severity 4) is the most prominent artifact. The structural collapse of the top edge (severity 3) indicates a failure to render rigid plastic geometry correctly. The surface texture is unnaturally smooth/waxy (severity 2), lacking the micro-details of real plastic. These artifacts compound to create a low-quality, obviously AI-generated appearance. The artifact score is penalized heavily due to the combination of semantic failure (text) and geometric failure (wavy edge).
